member of the Gosling Society

She was a Gosling as Mignonette 1866/7-?9, her address 23 Maryon Road, Woolwich, and she was probably this person, who was daughter of Lt Gen. C. W.

Younghusband (1821-1899), Superintendent of Royal Gun Factories, Woolwich.

If so, she married (1871) Lt.-Col.

George O'Malley.

She was accused by C.R.

Coleridge of carelessly mislaying the Barnacle [LG 1906 Younghusband, O'Malley].
